reasoning: This is a direct application of the Pigeonhole Principle. We have 5 pigeons but only 4 holes, with each hole allowed to hold at most 1 pigeon. That means at most 4 pigeons can be placed (one per hole), but we need to place 5. It is mathematically impossible. The SAT solver confirms UNSATISFIABLE.
